m008_quarantine_summary.note: M-008 is the single most critical metric. It is the FP floor — if random candidates score near 1.0, the matcher does not discriminate. Current value 0.9189 is ~18x above the 0.05 acceptance threshold. It does not regenerate (fresh=0.8889). Per MC-5, M-008 blocks ALL discovery claims. It is quarantined until the regeneration discrepancy is causally attributed.

No averaging. The discrepancy must be causally attributed before M-008 can be trusted. Per MC-5, M-008 (FP floor > 5% blocks discovery claims) is the single most critical metric for the matcher discrimination study.
